newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates nudge up in all maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates nudge up in all maturities.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) nudged up in all maturities in step with the increase in the Central Bank's overnight borrowing rate to 10 from 9.9 percent, traders said on Thursday.
The Central Bank also raised its borrowing rate on term reverse repos, a move which was intended to attract more inflows and siphon liquidity, traders said.
"Interest rates have now reached bottom. We expected it to go up," a dealer said, adding inflation is also seen to rise in line with the changes in domestic oil prices.
